notes.title: 1.4.1 Hot fix Patch has been released
notes.content:
Islanders, 

Many of you pointed out that the purchase option for DLC in the game was diminished. We fixed that very crucial problem. 

CHANGELOG:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where DLC links would open in the background. You must have steam overlay enabled on in order for links to open now.
[/list]

- Your Paraiso Island team

notes.title: 1.4.0 Patch has been released
notes.content:
Aloha, Islanders. 

This one was a biggie. We solved a bunch of nasty little bugs that were lingering in the system. It's all good now. Keep enjoying the game. 


CHANGELOG:
[list]
[*] All starting items have been upgraded from Simple to Bronze rarity (more durable).
[*] Fixed an issue where Rico would have a conversation loop bug.
[*] Fixed an issue where wallpapers were not applying to walls and were being dropped.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Achievement for getting 1 week of daily bonuses could be bypassed by redeeming only on the 7th day.
[*] Fixed an issue where loading a saved game would not load trees and starfishes.
[*] Fixed a critical issue where the game would hang if you cleared your save file and started a new game.
[/list]

- Your Paraiso Island team

notes.title: Roll up, roll up... Paraiso Island is opening for tourists tomorrow
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy, Islanders![/h1]

Paraiso Island is coming to STEAM and will be open to visitors tomorrow. Help Noodoo to get set up, meet the other Islanders, engage in daily quests. We have curated a wonderful world for you with cute characters that all have their own incredible stories.

Get started with the free-to-play tourist version or get become a permanent island resident and find lots more things to do.

We are excited to get you all to shore.

Your Paraiso Island team.
